_about: Videos of Eastern Blok / the Goran Ivanovic Group on YouTube, found 2026-10-23 by searching YouTube for the band name. All were uploaded by fans, venues or the band; none are Doug's own uploads, and the site links to them rather than embedding them (the site's Content-Security-Policy blocks third-party frames on purpose). `date` is only set where the title or description says it, or where a log entry on the same date matches (see `how`); otherwise it is null. `lead` marks the clip the page shows first. Lengths are as YouTube listed them. `dateLabel` overrides the printed date where the exact day is only inferred.
